speaker: Doctor

Thank you for that description. Since the abdomen is tender on palpation and the baby is fussy, have you noticed any visible pulsation in the upper abdomen, or any "currant jelly" colored stools? Also, has there been any vomiting, particularly if it is green or bile-colored?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Jejunal Atresia.

The "dilated bowel segments with absence of gas in the rectum" combined with bilious vomiting (implied by the severity) and a normal ultrasound strongly points to a high intestinal obstruction. Since the ultrasound was normal, this rules out malrotation with volvulus and intussusception, leaving atresia as the primary suspect. We should proceed with an upper GI series to confirm the transition point and plan for surgical correction.
